resources.string: This app is a modified version of the open-source shihabal3amri/DiPlay project, adapted for Lynk OS N 2.0 (Android 9), with changes to connection flows, the interface and diagnostics.\n\nOriginal project author: shihabal3amri. Thanks to the contributors to DiPlay and its dependencies. This is an independent modification, not an official upstream DiPlay release.
No browser is available on this head unit. Open this address on your phone: %1$s
Your music, maps and calls.\nRight here in your car.
Wired and wireless history, together in one file.
Set up once. Ready for your next drive.
Choose a category. Your saved preferences stay with you.
Connect your iPhone with a data cable
Enable the car’s Bluetooth to continue. Your saved phone and pairing are kept.
Your saved phone is not in the car’s current paired-device list. Check Bluetooth settings, or select a phone that is already paired.
1. On iPhone, turn on Bluetooth and Wi-Fi.\n2. Open the car’s Bluetooth settings and pair this iPhone once.\n3. Return here to continue automatically. When asked on iPhone, allow CarPlay.
Next, DiPlay creates a temporary hotspot and sends its details to iPhone. No hotspot name or password to enter.
Keep iPhone Bluetooth and Wi-Fi on. DiPlay reuses the selected phone and pairing. Allow CarPlay if iPhone asks; an already authorized phone may not ask again.
Connect iPhone to the car’s USB data port and unlock it. Allow USB access on the car and Trust / CarPlay on iPhone if prompted. Saved trust is reused.
Select your iPhone from the paired devices once. DiPlay remembers it for your next connection; no need to pair again.
